text: 1993. My grandpa ran the MegaPress around the clock. Four million chrome foil covers of one comic. Captain Collectible, number one.
He swore they'd be worth a fortune someday. Then the shops sent nearly every copy back. Unsold. Unread.
He never even let me open one. The leftover ink went in those barrels.
Nobody read it. Not one person. The shops sent nearly all of it back, and Grandpa sat on the pile, waiting to get rich.
Back issues all the way down. Funny, though. Not one copy of Captain Collectible number one. Tumble's printed four million. Where'd they all go?
